pack.merlinlib.generated.description: Enchantments and tags generated by MerlinLib from its configuration files.
enchantment.merlinlib.unbreakable.desc: Locks the durability of an item. The first time it would be damaged it is repaired fully, and after that it never wears out.
gui.merlinlib.editor.title: MerlinLib Item Editor
gui.merlinlib.editor.name: Name
gui.merlinlib.editor.hint: Shift click - / + step %s; wheel over a row ±%s, ctrl+wheel ±%s; shift+wheel scrolls; the X in a row removes it
gui.merlinlib.select.title: Choose an enchantment
gui.merlinlib.select.hint: The list is built while this screen is open, so it costs nothing the rest of the time.
gui.merlinlib.confirm.title: Confirm
gui.merlinlib.confirm.warning: This will remove every enchantment from the item!
gui.merlinlib.health.title: Health Editor
gui.merlinlib.health.hint: Right click an entity to edit it; sneak right click to edit yourself. With "requires item" on, hold the health editor first
gui.merlinlib.health.invalid: Enter 0 or a positive whole number
gui.merlinlib.health.need_item: Hold the health editor to edit (turn off "requires the item" in the settings)
gui.merlinlib.macro.title: Command Macros
gui.merlinlib.macro.name: Name
gui.merlinlib.macro.key: Key (several may be held together; X in a row deletes that macro)
gui.merlinlib.macro.hint: Click a macro to select it (the X in a row deletes it); press the key button to start a capture, click that button again to bind a mouse button, press the keys to hold together (press one again to remove it); click elsewhere to keep it, Escape cancels and restores the previous binding
gui.merlinlib.macro.capturing: Capturing: %s (click elsewhere to finish, Escape cancels)
message.merlinlib.content.failed: %s MerlinLib content definitions failed to load, see the log
message.merlinlib.disabled: MerlinLib is disabled by the server configuration
message.merlinlib.tools.empty_hand: Hold an item before opening the editor
message.merlinlib.no_permission: MerlinLib: this server has not granted you permission to use that tool
command.merlinlib.list.empty: MerlinLib defines %s enchantment(s) but none of them reached the registry. Check the "generated datapack" log line.
command.merlinlib.list.header: MerlinLib enchantments present in the registry: %s
command.merlinlib.list.others: Enchantments of other mods / data packs in the registry (not vanilla, not managed by MerlinLib): %s
command.merlinlib.not_in_registry: %s is not in the enchantment registry
command.merlinlib.book.given: Gave the enchanted book of %s at level %s
command.merlinlib.player_only: This command can only be run by a player
command.merlinlib.pack.empty: The generated in-memory pack currently contains no files: check that config/MerlinLib/enchantments.json parses
command.merlinlib.editorhotkey.on: Item editor hotkey enabled (written to client.toml)
command.merlinlib.editorhotkey.off: Item editor hotkey disabled (written to client.toml)
merlinlib.notice.config_ui: MerlinLib: to keep the code small, the configuration screen was rebuilt for 0.9.0; on Forge and Fabric the visual configuration screen needs Cloth Config API or Jupiter. This notice can be switched off in the configuration file.
message.merlinlib.config.needs_cloth: MerlinLib: the visual configuration screen needs Cloth Config API, which is not installed. Edit config/MerlinLib/client.toml instead.
config.merlinlib.title: MerlinLib settings
config.merlinlib.hud.collapse_enabled: Fold a very large health bar
config.merlinlib.hud.armour_auto_dodge: Move the armour row onto the folded bar
